headline: Agreed to send a draft library budget to the City that includes staff needs and service demand.
summary: Discussed the Koha catalog switch, the FY 28 budget timeline, and FY 26 spending, which went over budget partly because the Koha migration was not in the budget. Agreed to put forward a draft budget, and approved the August 13, 2026 minutes unanimously.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 13, 2026 meeting unanimously.
Agreed to put forward a draft FY 28 budget that includes library and staff needs; a first draft will be prepared before the City's deadline.

decision_evidence.quote: Upon a motion made by Trustee Stacey Pape and seconded by Trustee Marty Reid, the Trustees voted unanimously to accept the minutes of the August 13, 2026 Board of Trustees Meeting.
The Board agreed to put forward a draft budget that appropriately includes the needs of the library and the staff.
